model.title: A resolution congratulating the University of Oklahoma baseball team for winning the 2026 National Collegiate Athletic Association Division I Baseball Championship, the third national championship in program history.

summary.text: The resolution congratulates the University of Oklahoma baseball team on winning the NCAA Division I Baseball Championship, marking the program's third national title in its history.
